title: MCP server config injected into a spawned CLI
description: The MCP configuration Cowrite auto-wires into every spawned CLI session (TD-1). Schema empirically captured in SPIKE-1 (docs/spikes/spike1-provider-contract.md §4.3) from GitHub Copilot CLI; Claude Code's `--mcp-config` accepts the same `mcpServers` shape. TD-1's loopback-HTTP + per-session bearer design maps 1:1 onto the `http` transport with an `Authorization` header.

type.description: `local` = stdio transport; `http`/`sse` = network transports (loopback only for Cowrite).

tools.description: Per-server tool filter: "*", a list, or none.
